en: Black‑and‑white view down a broad European city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A tramcar runs along tracks in the middle, while pedestrians and a horse‑drawn wagon move along the cobbled roadway. In the foreground left is a small monument or fountain with a statue and an iron railing around it. Shopfronts with awnings and German‑language signs line both sides of the street. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century urban scene.
